description: This file implements Wayland shell protocol handlers, including functions for managing xdg positioners, toplevel windows, popups, and surfaces, with logging and resource management.

methods.name: xdg_positioner_destroy
methods.description: Destroys an xdg positioner resource.

methods.name: xdg_positioner_set_size
methods.description: Sets the size of an xdg positioner.

methods.name: xdg_positioner_set_anchor_rect
methods.description: Sets the anchor rectangle for an xdg positioner.

methods.name: xdg_positioner_set_anchor
methods.description: Sets the anchor point for an xdg positioner.

methods.name: xdg_positioner_set_gravity
methods.description: Sets the gravity for an xdg positioner.

methods.name: xdg_positioner_set_constraint_adjustment
methods.description: Sets the constraint adjustment for an xdg positioner.

methods.name: xdg_positioner_set_offset
methods.description: Sets the offset for an xdg positioner.

methods.name: xdg_toplevel_destroy
methods.description: Destroys an xdg toplevel resource.

methods.name: xdg_toplevel_set_parent
methods.description: Sets the parent of an xdg toplevel.

methods.name: xdg_toplevel_set_title
methods.description: Sets the title of an xdg toplevel.

methods.name: xdg_toplevel_set_app_id
methods.description: Sets the application ID for an xdg toplevel.

methods.name: xdg_toplevel_show_window_menu
methods.description: Shows the window menu for an xdg toplevel.

methods.name: xdg_toplevel_move
methods.description: Initiates a move operation for an xdg toplevel.

methods.name: xdg_toplevel_resize
methods.description: Resizes an xdg toplevel.

methods.name: xdg_toplevel_set_max_size
methods.description: Sets the maximum size for an xdg toplevel.

methods.name: xdg_toplevel_set_min_size
methods.description: Sets the minimum size for an xdg toplevel.

methods.name: xdg_toplevel_set_maximized
methods.description: Maximizes an xdg toplevel.

methods.name: xdg_toplevel_unset_maximized
methods.description: Unmaximizes an xdg toplevel.

methods.name: xdg_toplevel_set_fullscreen
methods.description: Sets an xdg toplevel to fullscreen.

methods.name: xdg_toplevel_unset_fullscreen
methods.description: Unsets fullscreen for an xdg toplevel.

methods.name: xdg_toplevel_set_minimized
methods.description: Minimizes an xdg toplevel.

methods.name: xdg_popup_destroy
methods.description: Destroys an xdg popup resource.

methods.name: xdg_popup_grab
methods.description: Grabs an xdg popup.

methods.name: xdg_surface_destroy
methods.description: Destroys an xdg surface.

methods.name: xdg_surface_get_toplevel
methods.description: Creates a toplevel xdg surface.

methods.name: xdg_surface_get_popup
methods.description: Creates a popup xdg surface.

methods.name: xdg_surface_set_window_geometry
methods.description: Sets window geometry for an xdg surface.

methods.name: xdg_surface_ack_configure
methods.description: Acknowledges a configure event for an xdg surface.

methods.name: xdg_shell_destroy
methods.description: Destroys the xdg shell.

methods.name: xdg_shell_create_positioner
methods.description: Creates a new xdg positioner.

methods.name: xdg_shell_get_xdg_surface
methods.description: Creates an xdg surface.

methods.name: xdg_shell_pong
methods.description: Handles pong response for xdg shell.

methods.name: BindShellInterface
methods.description: Binds the xdg shell interface to the Wayland display.
